# SCI-MAP v0.2 Scope Brief entry

Status: package-local nonnormative locator and program-adherence wrapper for
the owner-approved exact Scope Brief. It does not restate or modify the approved
scientific scope.

## Program adherence and prior-work recovery

This entry follows the [scientific-contract charter](../../../README.md), the
[pilot process](../../../PILOT_PROCESS_REVIEW_2026-08-16.md), the
[downstream roadmap](../../../DOWNSTREAM_CONTRACT_ROADMAP_2026-08-26.md), and
the frozen [SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.7.1 predecessor](../v0.1/SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_FREEZE_R0.7.1.md).
The implementation-blind [sanitized recovery](PRIOR_WORK.md) records adopt,
cite, supersede, defer, and exclude dispositions. No genuinely new scientific
derivation remains. The exact allowed author inputs are the 56 files in
[AUTHOR_REFERENCES.json](AUTHOR_REFERENCES.json), the exact brief, and the
owner approval; implementation-derived material remains excluded.

The normative approved brief is preserved byte-for-byte as
[SCOPE_BRIEF_APPROVED_EXACT.md](SCOPE_BRIEF_APPROVED_EXACT.md), SHA-256
`0b0504ccdcda3d5844c85f7cc563fb81b47f9bb9fb28dda6438cbc8bd368a8bc`.

[`studies/SCI_MAP_POST_FREEZE_RECONCILIATION_2026-09-07/SCOPE_BRIEF.md`](../../../studies/SCI_MAP_POST_FREEZE_RECONCILIATION_2026-09-07/SCOPE_BRIEF.md).
